chunks.rationale: electron/test/project-icon.test.js is the contract: candidate order (solenta.json / t3.json / well-known / HTML link), user override, traversal rejection, git-common-dir cache so a worktree reuses the main checkout's untracked favicon, data-URL size cap, and the services/IPC surface (iconPath persist, Automatic null, pick inside the project). Renderer tests cover the edit-project Appearance controls and that a missing iconUrl stays text-only in the scope menu and thread cards.
risks: macOS git --path-format=absolute resolves /var/folders through /private/var — tests must realpath, production already does via git.
Worktree integration needs a real git that supports `worktree add`. The unit cache test injects gitCommonDir so it does not.
Renderer tests inject iconUrl on ProjectInfo; they never run the disk resolver.

chunks.rationale: electron/projectIcon.js is the resolver. Order is override → solenta.json iconPath → t3.json iconPath → FAVICON_CANDIDATES (T3 list plus static/favicon, icon.png, app-icon) → <link rel=icon|/shortcut icon> and root.tsx-style metadata in a short file list. Scan root is the repo's main work tree (parent of git-common-dir when that basename is .git), so a worktree-as-project still sees the main checkout's gitignored favicon. Cache key is common-dir + override; a fall-through that later finds the override file is invalidated. Paths stay inside the root; http(s)/data hrefs and files over 256KB are skipped. iconUrl is derived only — migrateProject strips it, list/update/add clone it onto the return value.
risks: Cold projects:list shells out to git once per checkout (2s timeout) then caches common-dir for 60s. A missing git binary falls back to the given path.
Remote-only projects whose local path does not exist get no auto icon. Override still works if that relative file exists on the local path.
HTML extraction uses T3's anchored <link> regex (#5530 ReDoS). Source files larger than 512KB are skipped, not scanned.
Override relative paths are stored posix. Windows pickers go through path.relative then slash-normalize; a future store that writes backslashes is healed on migrate.

chunks.rationale: Project.iconPath is the persisted override (null/empty = Automatic). EditProjectModal Appearance is Choose a project file + Automatic; iconPath is only sent when dirty so a name-only save is unchanged. Sidebar scope trigger/menu and thread/slim cards render ProjectIcon when iconUrl is set and nothing otherwise. New IPC: projects:pickIcon (dialog, must stay in the project or main work tree) and projects:resolveIcon (preview without save). Wired through preload, wireClient, fakeCoder, and the browser mock.
risks: Web mode hides Choose a project file (no native dialog); Automatic still works. A browser-side file input is out of scope.
Planboard / PRs / activity views still text-only. #384 tray and #186 deep links are not consumers yet — they should read project.iconUrl, not re-resolve.
A 256KB SVG on every project would bloat projects:list. Real favicons are a few KB; the cap is the backstop.

Not verified in a live Electron window this turn — electron + renderer tests only. Open a multi-project sidebar and Edit project → Appearance on the running app is the real check (solenta itself has no favicon, so expect the No icon fallback unless you pick a file).
Did not add icons to the planboard project filter, PR list headers, or the menu-bar tray (#384). The derived iconUrl is the feed.
solenta.json is a one-key peek for iconPath, not the #438 layered config system. A future config loader should keep this key.
